frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Rational route to randomness: as the intensity of choice (or chartist extrapolation) rises, the fundamental steady state of an adaptive belief system loses stability through a Neimark-Sacker (Hopf) bifurcation into invariant cycles and complex dynamics.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Rational Route to Randomness: Bifurcation Instability
